notes: Only the home page carries pricing. Plans are traffic-based ('Traffic based plans that match your growth'): the displayed amounts ($9, $14, $19 per month) are for the default slider position 'Up to 10k monthly pageviews'; '10M+' shows 'Custom'. A Monthly/Yearly toggle ('2 months free') is shown but no yearly amount is captured, and the currency is resolved client-side (a JavaScript fragment 'response.json()).then(data => currency=data.currency)' leaks into the text; USD assumed from the '$' sign - product owner to confirm). 'usage' is accepted because the price depends on pageview volume. Enterprise has no price ('Contact us'). 30-day free trial, no free plan; pricing_status left unannotated because the open-source self-hosted version ('run it yourself if you want to') makes paid vs freemium debatable. 'Paying subscribers 22k', 'over 22,000 paying customers', '2,400 teams have been paying ... five years or longer' and '$1 million in annual recurring revenue in 2022' are company-stated figures, not verified payment proof (payment_confirmed / customer_verified stay forbidden). founded_year 2018 from 'started Plausible in December 2018' / 'running since 2018'; launch_year neither expected nor forbidden ('Paid subscriptions launched in 2019' could be read as launch). Team of 11 stated explicitly. The company is 'based in the EU' / 'Made and hosted in the EU' with no country or city stated in these pages (the Imprint page was not captured), so country_code and city are forbidden. 'Affiliates' appears only as an analytics channel grouping and in 'never spent a cent on advertising, affiliates or paid endorsements': incidental. Core product: privacy-friendly web analytics, eligible. The snapshot recorded one failed link (an http_404 on a malformed URL built from page JavaScript).
